original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: User-assigned full audited replay of PR4633 at b2998bacd50d57c301fe67c5392054440c42398c, and its nine-file b390d64abfcdba1a3816b86fc763cbc95d43c12c update, including both changed packages, all stated one-dimensional kernel scans, rational frame/source checks, controller boundary review and adversarial verifier controls.
scope_change_reason: Explicit audit assignment of the ambient-quotient replacement for the BIT supplier; this does not propose a helper-mixing construction.
bottleneck_link: A lower numeric invoice can improve kappa only after its word satisfies the native supplier and outer admission contracts. This audit tests that implication.
stop_rule: Finish submitted replays and finite scans, source-bound counterexamples, exact-head review evidence and an audit PR; do not promote the selected result.
evidence: Both registered replays and regenerated artifacts pass; independent rational-kernel and controller-boundary obstructions plus a free-MOVE false-positive control are reproducible in verify.py. Detailed coverage is in README.md and REPLAY.json. Current-head counterexamples are in verify_latest.py and EXPECTED-LATEST.json.
author: Cinna Davis, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for source review, exact arithmetic, replay, counterexamples and audit writing; no independent human or formal-kernel theorem review claimed.
